help_lines: ## Need help?

SAB Team Hub lets one team member at a time work on the shared Scripture App Builder project. It locks the project, gives you a verified local working copy, and sends your completed work back to the shared master.
## Before you start
1. Connect the team drive or shared folder and wait until it has finished synchronising.

2. Collect any new pictures or audio files and make sure you know which project folder they belong in. Do not copy them directly into MASTER. After you choose START WORK, the Hub will open the safe local Resources folders for you.
3. Close Scripture App Builder. SAB Team Hub must open it with the correct project and folder settings.
4. Check the project status. If another person holds the lock, wait until that person finishes.
5. Save unrelated work and close old project copies. Work only in the project opened by SAB Team Hub.
If you are unsure where a resource belongs, stop and ask the project administrator. Do not guess and do not make another project copy.
## The normal workflow
1. Open SAB Team Hub, identify yourself if asked, and choose the project.
2. Choose START WORK. The Hub verifies the master and SAB version, locks the project, receives a local copy and verifies it.
3. Before SAB opens, choose whether to add pictures, audio, both, or no resources. The Hub opens the correct local folder. Copy the files there, return to the Hub and review its summary.
4. Work normally in the SAB window opened by the Hub. Keep the Hub window open.
5. Save your work and close SAB completely.
6. Choose SEND AND FINISH. The Hub compares your work with the received version, backs up files when needed, sends the changes, verifies the new master, records the transaction and releases the lock.
Do not switch off the computer, disconnect the shared storage or close the Hub during a receive or send. Wait for confirmation that verification succeeded and the lock was released.
## Where the files are
Shared central location:
<central location>\<project>\MASTER\App Projects   - SAB application definitions
<central location>\<project>\MASTER\Contents       - text and content files
<central location>\<project>\MASTER\Keystore       - project signing material
<central location>\<project>\MASTER\Resources      - shared pictures, fonts and resources
<central location>\<project>\MASTER\Resources\Audio - shared audio files
<central location>\<project>\CONTROL                - manifests, version information and lock
<central location>\<project>\HISTORY                - transaction and lock history
<central location>\<project>\BACKUPS                - safety copies
MASTER is the authoritative team copy. Do not edit it manually. CONTROL, HISTORY and BACKUPS are managed by SAB Team Hub.
Your local location:
<local location>\<project>\_PARTAGE\Resources       - local pictures and resources
<local location>\<project>\_PARTAGE\Resources\Audio - local audio files
<local location>\<project>\_LOCALE                  - local output, reports, settings backups and Hub state
SAB works from _PARTAGE. The Hub refreshes it when you start and compares it with the received baseline when you send. Files in _LOCALE stay on your computer.
## Important rules
- Always enter the project through SAB Team Hub.
- Never edit the central MASTER directly and never copy the complete project by hand.
- Never work in an old or manually copied project folder.
- Do not edit the project while another person holds the lock.
- Replacing an existing resource requires your confirmation. Deleting files requires confirmation when you send.
- If you stop without sending, the lock may remain yours and block the team.
- If an error appears, do not delete your local folder or repair the central folders manually. Note the message and contact the administrator.
## Menu options
START WORK - receive the latest verified project, take the lock, prepare resources and open SAB.
SEND AND FINISH - publish your completed work, verify it and release the lock.
FINISH WITHOUT SENDING - release the lock only when you made no changes.
View project status - see the central version and who holds the lock.
Need help? - show this page.
Change this computer's identity - choose another registered team member or interface language.
Exit - close the menu without starting work.
